behavior: AC1: a FAIL line with a run/re-run/recover-with/upgrade-with remedy prints a Next steps: block after Results: listing the command
AC2: a WARN line with the same remedy pattern does not produce a Next-steps entry
AC3: a diagnostic-only backtick span on a FAIL line (not introduced by one of the four verbs) is not mistaken for a remedy
AC4: the same command repeated across FAIL lines is listed once
AC5: a clean run (no FAIL) prints no Next steps: block
AC6: --quick mode is covered by the same logic with no special-casing
AC7: tee-ing the report writer into a transcript buffer does not disable ANSI color on a real terminal run
